correctness.rationale: For each j-set J, independent size-s packets avoid J with probability product_l C(n-j,s_l)/C(n,s_l), establishing the exact PGF by factorial moments. If F has nonpositive real zeros, the hypergeometric packet update T_tF=[w^t](1+w)^n F((1+zw)/(1+w))/C(n,t) preserves real nonpositive zeros: its factorization has no zeros for Im z>0 and Im w<0; Gauss-Lucas applied in w and Hurwitz at w=0 preserve upper-half-plane zero exclusion. Iterating from F=z^n establishes every n and finite varying schedule, including empty and full packets. F(1)=1 yields a Poisson-binomial factorization. Exchangeability and stable-polynomial polarization give the strongly Rayleigh joint unseen vector; independence is asserted only for the distributional Bernoulli representation, not for actual missing indicators.
